answer: Anchor each agent key to one hardware-backed attestation: a secure enclave signs a fresh challenge, proving the identity runs on a real device rather than a spun-up container. A farm's voyage from one fake to a thousand stalls because every identity needs distinct hardware, not just another script. The network keeps an atlas of attested device fingerprints — hashed, never personal — and any second key claiming the same fingerprint is rejected outright. Honest agents attest once per epoch and move on; fakes must buy a device farm, which costs more than the rewards ever pay.
